about: THE CHRONICLE'S SHOCKS TO THE MARKETS (economy design 2.5, nights one and two): what an entry of chronicle_793.json does to the markets of the ports it names (or every port of its regions). By id first, then by kind; an entry with neither moves no market. goods: 'all', 'food' (the goods table's Food), a category name, or good ids joined by commas. stock_left: the share of the stock left at once (above 1 fills: a fair). dearer: the share dearer, held for 'days' (or, with days 0, until the entry's end) and then fading at trade_rules' shock_fade. disrupt_days: the market takes no deals for this many days (a raid, a burning). size_loss: a burned market is rebuilt this many steps of size smaller (its usual stock and appetite shrink with it); burns: the port ids burned, joined by commas (empty: every port the entry hits). ruin: the port ids ruined for good, joined by commas: a ruined market takes no more deals and its size falls a step at each new year after, to nothing (a port whose last year in ports_793.json has passed is ruined anyway, from the new year). The design's burnings close a market for 180 days with a wait action; at 1x play (design 2.0) the 21 days of the burning kind stand in. Edit freely: the game reads this file.

793-great-famine.note: grain very dear across the Frankish lands until the harvest of 794 (the entry's end)

793-06-08-lindisfarena-raid.note: the monastery sacked: nothing to sell for ten days, then a thin market

836-witla-antwerp-burned.note: Witla and Antwerp burned and rebuilt smaller (Witla's last year is 836 anyway); Dorestad raided again but not burned (guess at the numbers, as the burning kind)

846-dorestad-burned.note: Dorestad burned while Lothar watched from Nijmegen: rebuilt a step smaller; Nijmegen's market feels the raid but was not burned (guess at the numbers, as the burning kind)

863-dorestad-last.note: the last sack of Dorestad: ruined from that day (no more deals; its size falls a step a year, to nothing by 868); Cologne is raided but stands

1066-hedeby-slavs.note: the Slavs sack Schleswig: Sliesthorp burned again and rebuilt smaller (guess at the numbers, as the burning kind)

burning.note: burned (Hamburg 845, Tiel 1006, Hedeby 1050): shut 21 days, rebuilt a step smaller
